findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_address, check_endpoint, explore_tokens, submit_feedback · Private data: check_xrpl_token, check_address, check_endpoint, token_holders, resolve_asset, verify_price, explore_tokens, get_token_ohlc, get_wallet_activity, analyze_token_trend, quote_amm, find_best_path, watch_token · Public sink: check_address, token_holders, submit_feedback · Destructive: check_transaction, explore_tokens.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_address, check_endpoint, explore_tokens, submit_feedback · Private data: check_xrpl_token, check_address, check_endpoint, token_holders, resolve_asset, verify_price, explore_tokens, get_token_ohlc, get_wallet_activity, analyze_token_trend, quote_amm, find_best_path, watch_token · Public sink: check_address, token_holders, submit_feedback · Destructive: check_transaction, explore_tokens

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
